Confederate imprint. Map of parts of Illinois, Missouri, and Kentucky in the environs of Cairo and New Madrid, showing roads, railroads, towns, troop positions at New Madrid, drainage, and fortifications at Cairo, Illinois, and Birds Point, Missouri. The following handwritten note appears to the left of the map: Dear Mr. Phillips: I send you some interesting maps. Two of local origins and scarce. This one must I suppose have been intended for correspondence. Yours truly William Beer. Description derived from published bibliography. Scale 1:316,800. LC Civil War Maps (2nd ed.), 296.5 Available also through the Library of Congress web site as raster image.
